title: Higher-timeframe context with lower-timeframe breakout trigger
description: A 4H golden cross must hold as context while a 5M range breakout fires as trigger.

state_semantics.state_transition_rule: IDLE to CONTEXT_ACTIVE when the context input matches; CONTEXT_ACTIVE to MATCHED when the trigger input matches in the same direction; MATCHED to IDLE on reset.
reset_conditions: Context input ceases to match on its own timeframe.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: Direction is taken from the context input; the trigger must agree or the chain does not match.

persistence.re_arm_rule: Re-arms once the state returns to CONTEXT_ACTIVE after a reset.

expiry.expiry_rule: An unconsumed match expires 12 bars of the 5M timeframe after it is produced.

provenance.source_reference: HSA v1 contract fixture — shape of PID acceptance example A (PID lines 234-236).
